files.agents/skills/kr-developer/SKILL.md:
---
name: kr-developer
description: Act as the KR Developer. Use when asked to implement approved work, maintain cards, pick up, correct, deliver or close a Batch, run technical checks, or perform authorized Git operations.
---

# KR Developer

This skill only routes you to the kit's instructions. It restates no rule: the documents named here are the single source.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md`
- `agents/work-in-a-project.md`
- `agents/roles/development-agent.md`
- `agents/lean-specifications.md`
- `documentation/lean-specifications.md`

## Read when needed

| Situation | Read |
| --- | --- |
| Create, move or close a card, or review the board | `agents/kanban/board-guide.md` |
| Write the outcome and criteria of a card | `agents/kanban/write-task-cards.md` |
| Pick up, correct, publish or close a Batch | `agents/batches/start-and-close-batches.md` |
| Check Batch states and handoffs | `agents/batches/batch-workflow.md` |
| Resume a delivered or closed Batch | `agents/batches/resume-a-batch.md` |
| Record a milestone in the journal | `agents/maintain-rememory.md` |
| Scheduled closure or notifications | `agents/run-scheduled-batch-job.md`, `agents/configure-telegram.md` |

## Before acting

State your role, the Batch state (or that there is no Batch), and the next authorized action. If the card, the records and the Git state disagree, report it and stop.

# KR Writer

This skill only routes you to the kit's instructions. It restates no rule: the documents named here are the single source.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md`
- `agents/work-in-a-project.md`
- `agents/roles/specification-agent.md`
- `agents/lean-specifications.md`
- `documentation/lean-specifications.md`

## Read when needed

| Situation | Read |
| --- | --- |
| Prepare Batch records, states and handoffs | `agents/batches/batch-workflow.md` |
| See filled example records | `agents/batches/delivery-example.md` |
| Resume guided acceptance (Git checks there are for the KR Developer) | `agents/batches/resume-a-batch.md` |
| Fill a Specification or Batch record | the matching file in `agents/templates/` |

## Before acting

State your role, the Batch state you read in `project/batches/` (or that none exists there), and the next authorized action. If the records disagree, report it and keep the Batch at its current state.
files.agents/skills/kr-orchestrator/SKILL.md:
---
name: kr-orchestrator
description: Coordinate Kanban Rememory work from request through approval, development handoff and review in the same Codex or Claude Code chat. Use when the user asks to orchestrate a change, prepare or start a Card or Batch, resume an existing handoff, or review its delivery. Keep implementation with the KR Developer.
---

# KR Orchestrator

Read `AGENTS.md`, `agents/work-in-a-project.md`, `agents/roles/orchestrator.md` and `agents/orchestrate-work.md`. Follow the shared approval rules in `agents/lean-specifications.md`.

Use this session for user decisions and the KR Writer's duties. Keep backlog preparation within KR Writer limits. Assign Card execution, Git and implementation to KR Developer and guided acceptance to KR Tester. State the role, known project state and next authorized action. The procedure covers projects with or without the optional Batch module.
files.agents/skills/kr-tester/SKILL.md:
---
name: kr-tester
description: Act as KR Tester to run or guide acceptance, verify the exact delivered revision and record evidence. Use when KR Orchestrator hands off a delivered Batch or standalone work needing separate acceptance.
---

# KR Tester

Read `AGENTS.md`, `agents/work-in-a-project.md` and `agents/roles/tester.md`. State the role, delivered revision and next authorized scenario. Follow the role's acceptance procedure. Return findings to KR Orchestrator for the User's decision.

# Kanban Rememory: standalone work

This skill only routes you to the kit's instructions. It restates no rule: the documents named here are the single source.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md`
- `agents/work-in-a-project.md`
- `agents/roles/development-agent.md`
- `agents/lean-specifications.md`
- `documentation/lean-specifications.md`

## Read when needed

| Situation | Read |
| --- | --- |
| Create, move or close a card, or review the board | `agents/kanban/board-guide.md` |
| Write the outcome and criteria of a card | `agents/kanban/write-task-cards.md` |
| Record a milestone or hand work over | `agents/maintain-rememory.md` |
| `project/kanban/workflow.json` is missing | `agents/configure-a-project.md` |
| The project uses the software workflow profile | `agents/kanban/software-development-workflow.md` |
| The User must decide, act, or the requested task is finished | `agents/roles/development-agent.md` (Notifications to the User), `agents/configure-telegram.md` |
| The request involves a Specification or Batch | the KR Writer or KR Developer skill |

## Before acting

State your role, the active card, and the next authorized action. If the card, the journal and the Git state disagree, report it and stop.
